artworks.title: Maximilian I, Son of Emperor Frederick III
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing, facing slightly to the right with his head turned to the left. He has a long, pointed nose, a medium length beard, wears a hat with draped fabric, and his hair flows down to his shoulders. He is dressed in elaborate robes with intricate patterns, adorned with a lined collar and edges, and wears a belt around his waist. The man is holding his left hand on his hip while his right hand points downward. A sword with an ornate handle lies near his feet. The background includes an arched architectural structure with detailed carvings, rolling hills, and a town or city in the distance under a sky with clouds.

artworks.title: Emperor Maximilian I
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing in a dignified pose. He is turned slightly to his right, with his head looking to the side, offering a profile view of his face. He has sharp features and medium-length wavy hair under an intricate hat. He wears elaborate robes with ornate patterns and decorations, suggesting high status or royalty. His attire includes a richly adorned cloak, embroidered with a large, decorative collar. He holds a scepter or staff in his right hand, with the left hand resting on the edge of his cloak. The background features architectural elements like columns and an archway, framing the figure against a mountainous landscape.

artworks.title: Maximilian I, Duke of Bavaria
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a person from slightly below the shoulders up. The individual is turned slightly to the right, with their head facing forward. They have a refined facial appearance with a mustache and short beard. The person is wearing ornate armor with a ruff collar. The background has a textured, hatched design within an oval frame bordered by Latin text detailing the person's title or position.

artworks.title: Maximilian I, Duke of Bavaria
artworks.description: An engraved portrait of a man is shown. The man is in formal attire with distinct facial features, including a moustache and goatee. His hair is styled back, and he is wearing an ornate collar with inscriptions around the border of the image.

artworks.title: Maximilian II, Roman Emperor
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a figure in historical European noble attire. The person is depicted from the torso up, with a slightly angled position. His head is turned to the left, looking directly at the viewer. He has distinctive facial features, including prominent eyes, a mustache, a small goatee, and short, wavy hair. The figure is dressed in elaborate armor with a high collar and a sash across his chest. The background is plain with an oval border containing Latin text identifying the figure as "Maximilianvs D. G. Elect." The portrait is engraved with detailed texture.

artworks.title: Maximilian II, Roman Emperor
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man standing against a background with inscriptions. He is dressed in ornate clothing, including a feathered cap, embroidered doublet, and cuffed sleeves. The man has a prominent nose, mustache, and a short beard. He is holding a letter or document in his left hand.

artworks.title: Maximilian II, Archduke of Austria
artworks.artist: Pieter de Jode II after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.description: The image shows a man in a waist-length portrait. He is positioned slightly facing left, with short, neatly combed hair, a full mustache, and beard. The man has angular facial features and a neutral expression. He wears ornate clothing, including a high white collar with ruffles, a patterned button-up shirt, and a fur-lined overcoat. A chain with a cross hangs around his neck. The man is enclosed in an oval frame with decorative elements at the bottom corners. The background has a textured pattern. Text below the image provides titles and credentials.

artworks.title: Maximilian II, Roman Emperor
artworks.description: The image features an engraved portrait showing a person from the chest upward. The individual faces forward with a slight gaze to the side, displaying a dignified posture. He has a bushy mustache, a well-groomed beard, and wears a flat, brimmed cap. The person is dressed in a richly decorated robe with a fur collar and wears an ornate chain with a sheep pendant around his neck. The background is a textured, neutral tone. Below the portrait is an inscription detailing the individual's titles and positions.

artworks.title: Sir Thomas Meautys, Secretary to Sir Francis Bacon
artworks.artist: William Greatbach after Paulus van Somer I
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing in an outdoor setting. He is posed with one hand on his hip and the other hand on the handle of a sword at his side. The man has a neatly trimmed beard and mustache, curly styled hair, and wears a large, feathered hat. He is dressed in elaborate historical clothing, including a detailed tunic with patterns, puffed shorts, high boots, and a sash draped across his chest. The background features a pastoral landscape with trees and clouds in the sky.

artworks.title: Sir Thomas Meautys, Secretary to Sir Francis Bacon
artworks.artist: William Greatbach after Paulus van Somer I
artworks.description: The image depicts a man standing in a confident pose. He has a neatly trimmed mustache and beard, and his hair is styled in curls. The man is wearing a wide-brimmed hat with a plume, a doublet with puffed sleeves, knee-length breeches, high boots, and a sash draped over one shoulder. He is holding a sword by his side, with one hand resting on his hip. The background shows a pastoral landscape with trees and open skies.

artworks.title: Catherine de Medici (?)
artworks.description: This image is a bust portrait of a person, displaying their upper body from the chest upwards. The person is positioned facing slightly to their left, with their gaze directed towards the viewer. The individual has a solemn facial expression with elongated features. The person's hair is styled in elaborate roll and braided patterns. They are wearing a high, pleated ruff collar and a detailed garment with button decorations, piping, and shoulder embellishments. A small cross pendant hangs around their neck. The background is an oval-shaped shaded pattern, framing the subject. There is a lightly drawn sketch and inscription at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Catherine de Medici, Wife of Henry II of France
artworks.description: The engraving depicts the upper body of a woman seated and facing slightly to her right. She has distinct facial features, short wavy hair styled back with a decorative headpiece adorned with pearls and jewels. She wears an intricate dress with fur trimming, holds an ornate fan in her right hand, and wears a pearl necklace and bracelet. In the background, there is a textured surface bordered by an oval frame with a Latin inscription.

artworks.title: Catherine de Medici, Wife of Henry II of France
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person from the waist up. The person is positioned facing slightly to the right, with a direct, forward-facing look. Their facial features include prominent eyes, a long nose, and a tight-lipped expression. The person's hair is curled and short, adorned with a cap that is part of an elaborate headdress. They are wearing a high-collared garment with a decorative ruff, and the clothing appears textured and ornate, with puffed sleeves. Around their neck is a large, ruffled collar. The background features a finely detailed design and text encircling the portrait within an oval frame, with additional text beneath the image on what looks like a paper surface.

artworks.title: Catherine de Medici, Wife of Henry II of France
artworks.description: The image depicts a seated woman from the waist up, in front of a desk, with her hands clasped together just above the surface. She has a serious expression, downturned eyes, a prominent nose, and a rounded face. Her hair is styled tightly to her head and covered by a cap. She wears a dress with an elaborate ruffled collar, long sleeves, and a plain fabric bonnet. In the background, there are fluted columns and a landscape with a castle and hilly terrain. The scene is framed by an ornate border with detailed engravings.

artworks.title: Claudia de Medici, Wife of Leopold of Austrian Tyrol
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of a woman with an elaborate dress, styled hair, and jewelry. She is posed formally with a composed expression. The engraved frame features baroque and classical elements, including cherubs and ornamental details, as well as symbols and Latin inscriptions.

artworks.title: Giovanni de' Medici
artworks.description: The image portrays the upper half of a man's body in a portrait. The man is turned slightly to the side, looking directly at the viewer. His facial features include rounded cheeks, a mustache, and curly hair styled close to his head. He is dressed in elaborate attire typical of a high-status individual from the Renaissance period, with a textured garment, intricate patterns, and a large ruff collar. He holds an object in his right hand and the background is plain within an oval frame with decorative text surrounding it.

artworks.title: Marie de Medici, Wife of Henry IV of France
artworks.description: The image is an oval portrait of a woman showing her upper body, positioned facing the viewer directly with a composed demeanor. She has high eyebrows, a straight nose, and slightly pursed lips. She has an elaborate hairstyle and wears a richly adorned gown with a high lace collar. The gown has decorative patterns and rows of pearls. She wears pearl earrings and there are adornments in her hair. The background is a dark oval. Surrounding the portrait is text identifying the subject as a distinguished figure.

artworks.title: Marie de Medici, Wife of Henry IV of France
Marie de Medicis, Queen of France
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a woman comprising the upper half of her body. She is facing slightly to the right with her eyes looking straight ahead. Her features include smooth skin, large eyes, a high forehead, and a small mouth. Her hair is styled in an updo. She is wearing richly detailed clothing, including a high ruff collar with intricate patterns and embellishments, ornate sleeves, and earrings. The background consists of a shaded circular frame, with text around her image and additional text below the portrait.

artworks.title: Marie de Medici, Wife of Henry IV of France
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of Marie de' Medici seated in a regal position. Her oval face with soft features is detailed, along with her hairstyle and clothing. She wears an intricate dress with a large ruff collar and a cape, holding a scepter. The background features two figures on the left and an architectural scene on the right. In the lower part, there is a block of text in elaborate script.

artworks.title: Marie de Medici (?)
artworks.description: The image shows the upper-half of a seated woman. She is upright, with one arm resting on a patterned surface, possibly a table. Her facial features are detailed, with a calm expression and high cheekbones. Her hair is styled in an elaborate, voluminous coiffure typical of the period depicted. She is dressed in richly detailed clothing with a high, lace-trimmed collar and ornate bodice. Around her neck hang multiple strings of beads, and she wears an intricate pendant piece. Her hand is adorned with rings and is poised gracefully. The background consists of a textured shading with a curtain on the left and an emblem or coat of arms on the upper wall to the right.

artworks.title: Marie de Medici, Wife of Henry IV of France
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a woman from the chest-up in a formal, frontal position. She has a composed expression with distinct facial features, including arched eyebrows, forward-set eyes, a pronounced nose, and a small mouth. Her hair is styled elegantly with an ornament. She wears elaborate clothing, featuring a large ruffled collar or ruff with intricate designs. The background is an ornate oval frame with floral and scrollwork designs, accompanied by text. She appears to be wearing earrings. Additional text is included below the portrait.

artworks.title: Marie de Medici, Wife of Henry IV of France
artworks.description: This image shows a portrait of a woman depicted from the waist up. She is positioned facing forward, looking directly at the viewer. Her facial features are distinct and include a prominent forehead, high cheekbones, and a small mouth. Her hair is styled in a voluminous manner, adorned with jewels or decorative elements. She wears an elaborate, high lace collar and an ornate garment that appears to be richly patterned. She holds a cross between the fingers of her right hand. The woman is wearing earrings and other visible jewelry adorns her attire. The background is filled with engraved texture patterns, enclosing her in an oval shape. Surrounding the portrait, there are inscriptions and a decorative border that includes figures of cherubs or mythical creatures.

artworks.title: Maria de Medici
artworks.description: The image displays a portrait of a woman from the chest up. She is facing slightly to the side with her gaze directed towards the viewer. The woman's facial features include a high forehead, arched eyebrows, and a soft expression. Her hair is styled in an elaborate manner, arranged into a high coiffure with curls and a possible bun. She is wearing detailed clothing with beadwork and patterns, along with a high lace ruff collar encircling her neck. The fabric around her shoulders is ornamented with circular patterns, and she is adorned with sizable earrings, bows, and pearl drops. The background is plain to draw attention to the portrait's intricate details.
